products.title: Telescopic Covers
products.label: 01 / WAY DEFENSE
products.description: Heavy-duty multi-section box steel covers with brass gliders and polyurethane wipers, safeguarding CNC, VMC and HMC machine bedways against sharp hot chips, heavy coolant washdown and mechanical collision.

products.title: Roller Covers
products.label: 02 / RAPID APERTURE
products.description: High-velocity spring-tensioned roll-up curtains engineered with stainless steel bands or high-strength coated fabric for space-restricted machine axes, rapid cycle traverse, and coolant protection.

products.title: Apron Covers
products.label: 03 / SLAT DEFENSE
products.description: Flexible interlocking anodized aluminum slats with high-durability polyurethane hinge joints, providing rugged deflection against heavy chip bombardment, deep drop-offs, and roll-up way protection.

products.title: Bellows
products.label: 04 / EXPANSION SHIELD
products.description: Precision accordion way bellows crafted from multi-ply coated fabric with internal PVC stiffener guides and optional stainless steel lamella scales, sealing laser, grinding, and multi-axis CNC slideways.

products.title: Lip Wipers
products.label: 05 / WAY WIPERS
products.description: Precision-molded polyurethane and NBR elastomer guide wipers with rigid metal backings, continuously clearing microscopic fines, abrasive swarf, and fluid film to prevent guideway scoring.

products.title: Enclosing Guard
products.label: 06 / PERIMETER ARMOR
products.description: Complete modular machine tool safety cabins featuring heavy-gauge CRCA sheet steel panels, impact-resistant laminated polycarbonate viewing windows, safety interlocks, and 100% fluid mist containment.

finalShowcase.title: MODERN GUIDEWAYS CNC 5-AXIS CENTER
finalShowcase.description: Six precision-engineered machine protection systems converging into a unified, fully protected CNC machining center.
